summaries: An Annual Report on Form 10-K for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (which amended its name to American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Regarding the task: The Consolidated Balance Sheets report Cash and Cash Equivalents of $8,291 as of December 31, 2021, providing the baseline cash position immediately preceding the requested 2022–2024 trend period. While it confirms the entity's identity as BoxScore Brands prior to the name change—ensuring continuity with American Battery Materials, Inc.—this document does not contain the 2022, 2023, or 2024 financial statements required to analyze the cash trend over the specific timeframe requested.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Regarding the requested trend, the Consolidated Balance Sheets list Cash and Cash Equivalents of $42,582 for December 31, 2022, and $8,291 for December 31, 2021. Note 6 and the Overview disclose that on October 20, 2022, the company amended its Certificate of Incorporation to change its name to "AMERICAN BATTERY MATERIALS, INC." This document establishes the 2022 cash balance for the target entity but does not contain audited financial data for 2023 or 2024.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The document reports Cash and Cash Equivalents of $7,376 as of December 31, 2023, and $42,582 as of December 31, 2022. This supplies the 2023 data point for the trend analysis, though the document does not contain audited financial statements for 2024 required to complete the requested trend through that year.
